entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your natural spells are significantly increased, enabling you to feed and heal others.

Prerequisite(s): Con 15, character level 8th, ghoran, natural magic racial trait.

Benefit(s): Once per week, you can cast heroes’ feast as a spell-like ability with a caster level equal to your character level. If you do so, you lose access to the spells normally granted by the natural magic racial trait for the next 48 hours.
